scope: Read-only libretro VFS RAM filesystem overlay; cold boot; no state loads or guest memory edits. Infrastructure run does not certify repairs.

elf.format: ELF32BE SHF_ALLOC sections with LMA derived from containing PT_LOAD; no ELF header is executed

audio_gate.scope: No stability claim is permitted when disabled, reason, drops, ignored or music errors are observed. A passing gate alone is not complete audio or graphics validation.

audio_trace_sampling: HWRAM diagnostics every frame after signature; VDP1 ABI3 heartbeats at serialized checkpoints (300 frames and final).
